description: CRITICAL: Eliminate SQL injection vulnerabilities and exposed credentials. Replace all $queryRawUnsafe/$executeRawUnsafe with Prisma ORM methods or Prisma.sql tagged templates in search.repository.ts and saved-search.repository.ts. Update .env.example with secure placeholder credentials and generation instructions. Verify .env is in .gitignore (already confirmed present).
steps: 1. SQLINJECTION FIX - search.repository.ts: Replace searchProducts() raw SQL query with Prisma findMany using where clauses, OR conditions for name/description LIKE search, orderBy for sorting. Use string interpolation ONLY inside Prisma.sql`` tagged template if raw SQL absolutely required for complex ranking. Current lines 50-120 use $queryRawUnsafe with user input concatenation.

2. SQLINJECTION FIX - search.repository.ts: Replace getSearchSuggestions() at line ~230 - use Prisma findMany with where: { name: { contains: query, mode: 'insensitive' } }, orderBy: [{ orderCount: 'desc' }, { rating: 'desc' }].
3. SQLINJECTION FIX - search.repository.ts: Replace logSearch() at line ~245 - use prisma.searchLog.create() instead of $executeRawUnsafe.

4. SQLINJECTION FIX - search.repository.ts: Replace getPopularSearches() at line ~260 - use prisma.searchLog.groupBy({ by: ['query'], where: { createdAt: { gte: thirtyDaysAgo } }, _count: true, orderBy: { _count: { query: 'desc' } } }).
5. SQLINJECTION FIX - search.repository.ts: Replace getUserRecentSearches() at line ~280 - use prisma.searchLog.findMany with where, distinct, orderBy.
6. SQLINJECTION FIX - saved-search.repository.ts: Replace create() at line ~20 - use prisma.savedSearch.create({ data: { userId, ...data } }).
7. SQLINJECTION FIX - saved-search.repository.ts: Replace findByUserId() at line ~35 - use prisma.savedSearch.findMany({ where: { userId }, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' } }).
8. SQLINJECTION FIX - saved-search.repository.ts: Replace findById() at line ~55 - use prisma.savedSearch.findFirst({ where: { id, userId } }).

9. SQLINJECTION FIX - saved-search.repository.ts: Replace update() at line ~75 - use prisma.savedSearch.update({ where: { id }, data: { ...updates, updatedAt: new Date() } }). Add authorization check (userId match).
10. SQLINJECTION FIX - saved-search.repository.ts: Replace delete() at line ~115 - use prisma.savedSearch.delete({ where: { id } }). Add authorization check.

11. CREDENTIALS FIX - .env.example: Replace line 19 DATABASE_URL with placeholder: postgresql://agrimarket_user:CHANGE_ME_STRONG_PASSWORD@localhost:5432/agrimarket. Add comment: Generate with `openssl rand -base64 32`.
12. CREDENTIALS FIX - .env.example: Lines 26-27 JWT secrets already have placeholders but add generation instruction comment above them: # Generate with: openssl rand -base64 64
13. CREDENTIALS FIX - .env.example: Lines 56-58 SMTP credentials - already have placeholders (smtp.example.com, your-email@example.com). Verify EMAIL_FROM and EMAIL_FROM_NAME don't expose real email.
14. CREDENTIALS FIX - .env.example: Line 83 SESSION_SECRET already has placeholder but add generation comment: # Generate with: openssl rand -base64 64

15. CREDENTIALS FIX - Create SECURITY.md in backend/ root documenting: credential rotation procedure, what secrets exist, how to generate them, reminder to never commit .env, instructions to change all defaults before production deployment.
16. Add inline code comments in both repository files explaining why Prisma ORM prevents SQL injection (parameterized queries under the hood).
acceptance_criteria: Zero occurrences of $queryRawUnsafe or $executeRawUnsafe in search.repository.ts and saved-search.repository.ts
All database queries use Prisma Client methods (findMany, create, update, delete, groupBy) or Prisma.sql tagged templates
.env.example contains ONLY placeholder values with NO real credentials
.env.example includes openssl generation instructions for all secrets (JWT, SESSION, DB password)
SECURITY.md exists in backend/ with credential management documentation
TypeScript compilation succeeds: npm run lint passes in backend/
Existing search and saved-search functionality works identically (no behavior change, only implementation)
verification: Run `npm run lint` in backend/ - no TypeScript errors
Run `npx prisma generate` to regenerate Prisma Client after any schema changes
Grep check: `grep -r "\$queryRawUnsafe\|\$executeRawUnsafe" backend/src/repositories/search*.ts` returns no matches
Grep check: `grep -i "Sharon\|sharonkuye369\|tftzlyavgjyvjkcg" backend/.env.example` returns no matches
Manual verification: Read backend/.env.example and confirm all credentials are placeholders
Start backend dev server: `npm run dev` in backend/, hit search endpoint http://localhost:3001/api/v1/search?query=coffee, verify results returned
Run backend unit tests if search repository has tests: `npm run test:unit`
